title: toolvend - DNS, WHOIS & domain tools
description: DNS, WHOIS/RDAP, DMARC/SPF, LEI, sitemap, web extract, VAT, QR. Paid per call in USDC, no signup.
summary: DNS, WHOIS/RDAP, DMARC/SPF, LEI, sitemap, web extract, VAT, QR. Paid per call in USDC, no signup.
offersHint: DNS, WHOIS/RDAP, DMARC/SPF, LEI, sitemap, web extract, VAT, QR. Paid per call in USDC, no signup. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://toolvend.dev/mcp

toolsPreview.name: dns
toolsPreview.description: DNS lookup over DoH. Common record types (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CAA, ...) as clean JSON. Paid per call: $0.005 in USDC via x402.

toolsPreview.name: email-auth
toolsPreview.description: Email authentication posture for a domain: DMARC + SPF records fetched, parsed, scored 0-100, with findings and fix recommendations. Paid per call: $0.01 in USDC via x402.

toolsPreview.name: rdap
toolsPreview.description: Domain registration data (modern WHOIS) via RDAP: registrar, created/expiry dates, status, nameservers, DNSSEC. Paid per call: $0.005 in USDC via x402.

toolsPreview.name: lei
toolsPreview.description: Global legal-entity/KYB lookup by LEI: official identity, jurisdiction, addresses, registration and renewal standing, risk flags, and GLEIF data freshness. Paid per call: $0.008 in USDC via x402.

toolsPreview.name: sitemap
toolsPreview.description: Fetch and parse sitemap XML or gzip into JSON. For an index, follow the first N children with ?follow=N. Caps merged output at 500 URLs. Paid per call: $0.005 in USDC via x402.

toolsPreview.name: robots
toolsPreview.description: Fetch and parse robots.txt (+ llms.txt if present) into structured JSON, including which AI crawlers are blocked. Paid per call: $0.005 in USDC via x402.

toolsPreview.name: extract
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a web page and return structured content: title, meta/OpenGraph, canonical, headings, links, readable text (boilerplate stripped). Add ?render=true for JavaScript-rendered pages ($0.03). Paid per call: $0.01 ($0.03 Execute JavaScript with Cloudflare Browser Run before extracting content.) in USDC via x402.

toolsPreview.name: text-clean
toolsPreview.description: Clean text: strip HTML, normalise unicode/whitespace, dedupe lines. Returns cleaned text plus stats. Paid per call: $0.003 in USDC via x402.

toolsPreview.name: vat
toolsPreview.description: VAT calculator for EU-27 + UK: net→gross or gross→net at standard or reduced rate. Includes rates table snapshot date. Paid per call: $0.002 in USDC via x402.

toolsPreview.name: qr
toolsPreview.description: QR code generator. Returns a crisp SVG for text/URL payloads up to 2,048 UTF-8 bytes that fit the selected error-correction level. Paid per call: $0.003 in USDC via x402.
